1833344: Genesis 8 finds Noah still shut inside a dark, silent ark long after the rain has stopped, waiting on a God he can't see or check on. Pastor Trent Cornwell traces four things that wait teaches about God: His faithfulness was already at work before Noah could see it, He moves slowly because He's after completion rather than a quick fix, He never wants a "not yet" mistaken for a "never," and His word outweighs whatever our circumstances seem to say.
